bug_semantics: With self-registration enabled, an unauthenticated registrant's submitted password was hashed and retained as Inbox.data.password so an administrator could later create the account. The generic inbox index and view paths serialized that JSON payload without redaction to HTML, JSON, and CSV consumers; after Inbox acquired AuditLogBehavior, the same nested credential could also be copied unredacted into audit-log changes. An authenticated user with the required inbox or audit-log privileges could therefore obtain a pending registrant's password hash for offline cracking.
flaw_origin: Commit 370ae3438e468f168f5793a720125e6d53943bd1 converted the earlier dummy registration handler into public self-registration and, in the same commit, added src/Controller/UsersController.php's password field to the inbox payload plus libraries/default/InboxProcessors/UserInboxProcessor.php's hashing and parent::create() save. The already-existing generic InboxController index()/view() returned Inbox entities without credential filtering. Commit 2e1ee2d064c07322d7f074160a6de9d5512e43f6 later attached AuditLogBehavior to Inbox, adding a second disclosure surface, but the credential-in-unredacted-inbox mechanism was already vulnerable from 370ae3438e468f168f5793a720125e6d53943bd1.
ai_marker: absent: raw `git cat-file commit 370ae3438e468f168f5793a720125e6d53943bd1` shows author and committer `Sami Mokaddem <sami.mokaddem@circl.lu>` and message `new: [user:registration] Added user self-registration feature`; it has no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, bot identity, or other AI trailer/marker.
evidence: First-party release https://github.com/cerebrate-project/cerebrate/releases/tag/v1.37 describes the registration password-hash exposure in inbox index/view API responses, HTML view, and audit log, and says v1.37 redacts credential fields while retaining the stored value; GitHub advisory https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-88x3-39g9-9frv states Cerebrate before 1.37 is affected and links direct fix https://github.com/cerebrate-project/cerebrate/commit/02da6d708d610c8509a1aab3f58f53f0a91d8a04. `git log --reverse -L 739,764:src/Controller/UsersController.php` and `git log --all --reverse -S "DefaultPasswordHasher())->hash" -- libraries/default/InboxProcessors/UserInboxProcessor.php` identify 370ae3438e468f168f5793a720125e6d53943bd1 as the first commit adding the submitted password to Inbox.data and hashing it before parent::create(); `git blame -L 739,764 v1.36 -- src/Controller/UsersController.php` attributes the surviving password payload line to that full commit. Direct-parent tree inspection with `git show 43fbdc63f64d6b3295e4f111e494748772ea1d69:src/Controller/UsersController.php` and `git show 43fbdc63f64d6b3295e4f111e494748772ea1d69:libraries/default/InboxProcessors/UserInboxProcessor.php` shows no submitted password field, password hasher, or hashed-password save, while the parent's src/Controller/InboxController.php already has unredacted CRUD index()/view(). `git rev-parse 370ae3438e468f168f5793a720125e6d53943bd1^` returns exactly 43fbdc63f64d6b3295e4f111e494748772ea1d69. `git log -S "addBehavior('AuditLog')" -- src/Model/Table/InboxTable.php` finds later commit 2e1ee2d064c07322d7f074160a6de9d5512e43f6, confirming audit logging enlarged rather than originated the flaw. `git tag --contains 370ae3438e468f168f5793a720125e6d53943bd1` includes v1.0 through v1.36 (and later tags) but no v0.x tag; `git tag --contains 02da6d708d610c8509a1aab3f58f53f0a91d8a04` returns only v1.37 and v1.38. The v1.36 and v1.37 tag commits resolve to 6d0160ded30f7c0f94cc3d7af7efe26202316d40 and 9a308a10fd0958f59b801d66c50aa6e369276c4e; `git diff v1.36 v1.37 -- src/Controller/InboxController.php src/Model/Behavior/AuditLogBehavior.php src/Model/Table/InboxTable.php` shows the direct fix adding afterFind redaction to index/view, InboxTable::redactSensitiveData(), and recursive nested JSON redaction for audit values. Raw BIC commit-object inspection shows one parent, so this is not a merge or squash aggregate.
reasoning: The lifecycle starts when 370ae3438e468f168f5793a720125e6d53943bd1 first makes registration public, places the submitted password in the inbox payload, hashes it in the registration processor, and saves that payload through the pre-existing generic inbox machinery. Because the immediate parent has neither password payload construction nor hashing/storage, but already exposes complete inbox entities through index/view, the direct parent cannot exhibit this credential disclosure and parent absence is proven. Later refactors preserve the line, and 2e1ee2d064c07322d7f074160a6de9d5512e43f6 adds the audit-log copy of the same sensitive nested value; neither is smaller or earlier than the original inbox exposure. The BIC is present at the first v1 tag and through v1.36, while direct fix 02da6d708d610c8509a1aab3f58f53f0a91d8a04 first appears in v1.37, matching the project release and advisory boundary. The fix masks password/authkey on every inbox display/API path and recursively in audit-log JSON without breaking account creation. Attribution is based only on the raw 370ae3438e468f168f5793a720125e6d53943bd1 commit object: its human author/committer and trailer-free message contain no AI marker, so the closed verdict is NOT_AI.
